Discovery-only items such as E042 and E045 remain excluded from defensible estimates.","Local facts were appropriately used as contextual priors with attribution warnings; unused local facts are not evidence defects.","No scores, score ranges, anchors, rankings, or judge instructions are present.","Residual gaps are preserved for downstream confidence and interpretation; no missing evidence is treated as negative ruler evidence."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal no-search review after all permitted research rounds. The dossier materially improved across all chapters but remains uneven and not fully saturated. Chapter 7B has credible but non-adjudicated personal/network evidence; Chapters 1B, 2B, 3B, 4B, 5B, 6B, and 8B retain attribution, remedy, delivery, baseline, or contrary-evidence limitations. These residual issues should constrain confidence and interpretation downstream, without implying negative ruler evidence.","schema_version":"ruler_evidence_review_v1","selected_theme_ids":[]}
